title: Circuits and Power
blurb: 17 units deriving circuit theory from Maxwell's equations and following the energy, which travels in the fields outside the wires: Kirchhoff's laws as topology, alternating current and the transformer, transmission lines, three-phase power, the grid's stability, power electronics and HVDC, wireless charging and antennas. Every fact is derived on the page or cited to a named source.
needs: nothing installed — a browser and paper; it assumes Mechanics to Relativity through unit 24, published beside it, and links to its decks
site_is: the whole course — decks, problem sheets, hint ladders and worked solutions
